Here's where your order stands. Shop···· hasn't shipped. Your B30 and Power K. are waiting at our Tennessee warehouse until the batch 2 units are checked in. Nothing has been set aside for your order yet.

I can't give you a date I don't have. What I can tell you is that your request asks for a firm ship date for your order specifically, and it notes this has gone on for months. The team picks it up first thing tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer goes to your email.

If there's something specific you want them to deal with in that email, tell me now and I'll add it, so you don't have to explain it again.
